Bills vs Vikings DraftKings Showdown Picks: Monday Night Football NFL DFS Captains, Projections and Sim Plays

DraftKings Showdown · Monday Night Football, November 9 · NFL Week 9 · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 9, 7:08 PM ET

Josh Allen has the highest SPAGS projection in the Bills at Vikings DraftKings Showdown: 21.6 points at $11,400 FLEX, 32.5 at captain for $17,100. In a game totaled at 45.5, the model's favorite play is the quarterback who also runs. It has him carrying 6.7 times, and across 100,000 simulations he holds 73% of the winning-lineup credit. The case against Allen is his range, not his role: a simulated floor of 7.4 points at an $11,400 FLEX salary.

He also has the largest captain share: 24.4% of the simulated winning-lineup credit comes with Allen at captain. Justin Jefferson is the next captain in line, at 19.5%. The model gives him 7.5 targets on 27.4 routes.

Buffalo is a 3.5-point favorite, and the implied totals are 24.5 for the Bills and 21 for the Vikings.

Behind Allen and Jefferson, the next projections are James Cook III (18.2, $10,400), Carson Wentz (15.6, $9,000) and DJ Moore (11.5, $7,800).

Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 9, 7:08 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup and captain credit come from 100,000 simulations of the Showdown contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th. Showdown lineups use one captain, who scores 1.5x at 1.5x salary, and five FLEX players.

Chris Spags' latest NFL DFS breakdown on the Splash Play NFL channel.

MNF Showdown captain picks: who the sim wins with

Captain: Josh Allen, BUF QB ($11,400 FLEX / $17,100 CPT)

Josh Allen holds 24.4% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain, more than any other player in this game. At captain he costs $17,100 and the 21.6-point SPAGS model projection becomes 32.5 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model includes 6.7 rushing attempts. Across 100,000 simulations Allen averaged 21.6 points with a simulated floor of 7.4 and a ceiling of 43.8. He holds 73% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 24.4% as the captain and 48.5% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Justin Jefferson, MIN WR ($9,800 FLEX / $14,700 CPT)

Justin Jefferson holds 19.5% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $14,700 and the 17.9-point SPAGS model projection becomes 26.8 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 7.5 targets on 27.4 routes. Across 100,000 simulations Jefferson averaged 17.9 points with a simulated floor of 4.9 and a ceiling of 43.9. He holds 54% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 19.5% as the captain and 34.1% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: James Cook III, BUF RB ($10,400 FLEX / $15,600 CPT)

James Cook III holds 18.9% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $15,600 and the 18.2-point SPAGS model projection becomes 27.2 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 19.9 carries and 2.3 targets. Across 100,000 simulations Cook averaged 18.1 points with a simulated floor of 7.0 and a ceiling of 35.9. He holds 59% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 18.9% as the captain and 40.6% in a FLEX spot.

Carson Wentz, MIN QB ($9,000 FLEX / $13,500 CPT)

He holds 55% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 8.4% as the captain and 46.6% in a FLEX spot.

DJ Moore, BUF WR ($7,800 FLEX / $11,700 CPT)

DJ Moore carries the 5th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 11.5 DraftKings points for a $7,800 FLEX salary ($11,700 at captain). The model gives him 6.0 targets on 24.9 routes. Across 100,000 simulations Moore averaged 11.5 points with a simulated floor of 4.6 and a ceiling of 23.2. Across 100,000 simulations Hockenson averaged 10.0 points with a simulated floor of 1.8 and a ceiling of 24.9. He holds 34% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 5.6% as the captain and 28.8% in a FLEX spot.

Across 100,000 simulations Bass averaged 8.5 points with a simulated floor of 3.0 and a ceiling of 16.0. He holds 29% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 0.9% as the captain and 28.4% in a FLEX spot.

Josh Allen leads the SPAGS model at 21.6 DraftKings points for $11,400 at FLEX, or 32.5 points at captain for $17,100.

Josh Allen is the most expensive player at $11,400 FLEX and $17,100 at captain. All 30 players with a SPAGS projection are listed above with FLEX salary, captain salary and projection.

At $5,000 and under, the best projected points per $1,000 belong to Tyler Bass (8.6 points at $4,600), Will Reichard (7.9 points at $5,000) and Bills (6.2 points at $4,000).
